args.description: See what the notes service's client does
Save each line as a note
See how the client refuses a request that does not fit

args.command:
node - <<'EOF'
import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { notes } from '@fleet/notes'

const texts = (await notes.tagged({ tag: 'shop' })).notes.map(note => note.text)
writeFileSync('/tau/out/report.txt', texts.join('\n') + '\n')
console.log(JSON.stringify(texts))
EOF
args.description: Write the shop notes to the report

final: Saved the three notes, and wrote the two tagged shop to /tau/out/report.txt.
